parameters.jsCode:
return $input.all().map(item => {
    return {
        json: {
            row_id: item.json.row_id,

            Raw_Model:
                item.json.Raw_Model || "NotFound",

            Product:
                item.json.Product ||
                item.json["Product(EN)"] ||
                item.json.product ||
                "",

            Product_Description:
                item.json["Product Description"] ||
                item.json.Product_Description ||
                item.json.Description ||
                "",

            Exporter_Name:
                item.json["Exporter Name"] ||
                item.json.Exporter_Name ||
                item.json.exporter_name ||
                "",

            Importer_Name:
                item.json["Importer Name"] ||
                item.json.Importer_Name ||
                item.json.importer_name ||
                "",

            Importer_Address:
                item.json["Importer Add."] ||
                item.json.Importer_Address ||
                item.json.importer_address ||
                "",

            Importer_Country:
                item.json["Importer Country(EN)"] ||
                item.json.Importer_Country ||
                item.json.importer_country ||
                ""
        }
    };
});
